craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Boon-hand enacts; unstained-ever close. Rejected: (a) ever→always → killed: ever is endless. Read aloud: BY the-BOON-hand … UN-touched EV-er.

lines: By the boon hand, glory-giving enacted;
